correctness.rationale: The full (T1)–(T8) algebras are dual to tense H-spaces satisfying published (S1)–(S3). On an n-element dual chain, finite closed fibres and order convexity make rows intervals or empty. Both existential and universal negative modalities must preserve suffix upsets, forcing every row/column either empty everywhere or nonempty everywhere, monotone row endpoints a,b, full coverage a_last=0,b_first=n-1, and no uncovered column gaps b_(i+1)>=a_i−1. Conversely these conditions make every column an interval with nonincreasing endpoints and all four induced modalities preserve upsets; duality yields unique quadruple per admissible relation. The g-reduct recovers a exactly from g(U_t)={i:a_i<t}; counting monotone a gives 1+C(2n−2,n−1), including one empty reduct. Two explicit b completions give sharp minimum fibre 2 (n>=2), and a=all zero permits all C(2n−2,n−1) b. Independent enumeration of every interval-row relation and upset-preservation check for n=1..4 yields exactly 2,5,30,267 expansions and reduct counts 2,3,7,21 with matching predicted fibres, corroborating the unrestricted argument.
